Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

programme.desc: Parallel cut Joe dan Clara di sebuah pagi di rumah masing-masing, siap beraktivitas. Tak lama, di kedai kopi Joe yang riuh, Joe tiba dan menyelesaikan masalah diantrian. Terlihat Rori si robot kopi yang melayani pelanggan dan memutar musik sesuai selera pengunjung. Tak lama Clara tiba menyeruak antrian, membuat pengunjung lain protes, namun ia disambut Joe yang adalah teman lamanya. Mereka pun saling menyapa dan pergi menyusuri jalanan Surabaya untuk mengenang masa lalu kala pertama Clara melihat Joe saling bertemu.

programme.title: I Got Fitted For Brand New Golf Clubs
Joe & Robot Kopi S1 E2
programme.desc: Clara mendapat ide agar Joe mengotomatisasi proses pembuatan agar tak perlu menggunakan sepeda untuk membawa berbagai peralatan dan proses bisa lebih cepat. Joe diajak ke rumah Clara dan berkenalan dengan orangtua Clara. Mereka makan bersama sambil mengobrol dengan hangat. Saat Clara menanyakan robot yang ayahnya buat, ternyata robot itu sudah dibuang karena tidak berfungsi dan sering korslet sehingga Ayah Clara yang tak punya waktu untuk memperbaiki, ia malah membuangnya.

programme.title: Epic Knockout Golf Challenge - Good Good

Saat ini, banyak orang dapat dengan mudah meraih popularitas dalam waktu singkat. Hal tersebut tidaklah salah, namun menjadi dipertanyakan ketika popularitas, kekuatan, dan pengaruh tersebut tidak dimanfaatkan secara bijak.

programme.title: How To Play Bunker Shots - 3 Key Tips

programme.desc: Tim2one yang dikenal secara regional—atau Chandra Liow—memulai kanalnya dari video tutorial After Effects saat ia masih duduk di bangku SMP. Harbatah, yang sebelumnya dikenal sebagai Duo Harbatah, kini menjadi kanal yang dikenal luas dan pada awalnya memparodikan budaya Arab.

programme.title: Can He Keep Up - Pro Surfer vs College Golfer 1st Course Vlog

programme.desc: Kenalkan Rivaldo Santosa, sosok di balik kanal YouTube Detective Aldo yang dikenal luas karena membahas secara mendalam topik okultisme, kriminalitas, serta berbagai aspek sejarah Indonesia. Lalu ada Nessie Judge yang terkenal, seorang perempuan muda yang gemar membagikan fakta, cerita, dan informasi menarik kepada Nerrorists—sebutan khas untuk para pengikutnya.

programme.title: This App Will Change My Game - How Tour Pros Look At Stats
Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E4
programme.desc: Menampilkan grup musik Eclat Story (Yosua Gunawan, Yeshua Abraham, dan Louis Xander Liang), Rani Ramadhany, serta Eka Gustiwana—bagi mereka, musik adalah inti dari semangat dalam berkarya. Kecintaan mereka yang begitu besar terhadap musik dan bunyi tidak hanya memengaruhi cara mereka mengambil keputusan penting dalam hidup, tetapi juga menjadi faktor penentu dalam perjalanan hidup mereka.

programme.title: How To Stop Hitting Bad Iron Shots - 3 Really Simple Tips

programme.desc: Marlo Ernesto, Cania Citta Irlaine, dan Gritte Agatha menggunakan suara mereka sebagai alat yang kuat untuk menyampaikan pesan. More Than Words membuka ruang percakapan, memicu perdebatan sosial, menghibur penonton, dan masih banyak lagi.

programme.title: 2 V 2 Alternate Shot With Shee Sisters - Halloween Golf Special

programme.desc: Jovi Adhiguna Hunter adalah seorang pengusaha sekaligus content creator yang kerap membuat konten seputar fashion, kecantikan, gaya hidup, dan F&B. Lifni Sanders, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Livjunkie, adalah seorang perempuan berdarah Papua dan Tionghoa yang berprofesi sebagai content creator dengan menjadikan makeup dan skincare sebagai kontennya.

programme.title: 5 Simple Ways To Fix Your Golf Slice

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng berperan sebagai seorang pria yang konon hanya bisa dibunuh oleh sebuah pedang yang ditempa dengan tetesan air mata.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping dan Su adalah sepasang kekasih yang mengelola agen perjalanan khusus liburan ke Asia Tenggara. Seorang kepala sekolah bernama Tung beserta murid-muridnya bergabung dalam tur yang dipimpin oleh Ping.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: Setelah seorang pemerkosa keji membunuh sang guru dan seluruh klannya, Si Buddha Besi bertekad untuk membalas dendam. Namun tentu saja, ia membutuhkan sebuah pedang sakti.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: Setelah seorang pemerkosa keji membunuh sang guru dan seluruh klannya, Si Buddha Besi bertekad untuk membalas dendam. Namun tentu saja, ia membutuhkan sebuah pedang sakti.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Tiga sekawan menemukan sebuah artefak langka, tapi mereka diracun oleh Nyonya Wu yang ingin mencurinya. Sebelum tewas, ketiganya meminta istri mereka berjanji guna melatih anak mereka untuk mengambilnya kembali.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: Seorang putri bangsawan diculik oleh bandit Golden Dragon Hill yang terkenal kejam. Seorang pendekar pedang bernama Yue Zhen Bei ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkannya, dan ia menghadapi banyak bahaya dalam perjalanannya.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Ahli film laga Chang Cheh menceritakan kisah tentang Chin Feng yang bertemu dengan gadis cantik bernama Ting Hung saat tengah melarikan diri, setelah ia tak sengaja membunuh seorang pengganggu yang sombong.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, murid klan Huashan, ditugaskan untuk mencari penerus 'The Proud One'. Ling merasa Ying adalah orang yang tepat, tetapi ia menemukan bahwa Ying adalah putri dari pemimpin klan jahat.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang adalah seorang gadis yang tidak takut untuk melawan para preman. Sayangnya, ia mengira Ma Ta-hai yang tampan sebagai salah satu preman itu. Keduanya saling tertarik, namun mereka menolak untuk mengakuinya.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: Sekuel dari The Empress Dowager ini melanjutkan kisah Kaisar Guangxu dan Ibu Suri Cixi. Terlepas dari penobatan Guangxu sebagai raja, kemampuannya untuk memerintah secara efektif dibayangi oleh kekuatan Cixi.

programme.title: The Land Of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Biksu Tang San Zang, siluman kera, siluman babi, dan Sha Wu Jing berada di Womanland, tempat para wanita melahirkan bayi perempuan dengan meminum mata air ajaib.

programme.title: Melody Of Love
programme.desc: Kisah asmara yang mempesona ini bercerita tentang tiga dokter yang mengejar tiga gadis cantik di era musik 'a-go-go' pada tahun '70-an.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: Guo Jing bertemu Huang Rong dan mereka jatuh cinta. Di saat yang sama, Ouyang Ke melamar Huang Rong, sehingga ayah Huang mengatur sebuah duel untuk kedua pria tersebut.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: The Shepherd Girl, drama musikal tahun 1963 karya Shaw Brothers! Di film ini, Julie Yeh Feng berperan sebagai Hsiu Hsiu, gadis penggembala cantik yang jatuh cinta pada pelaut tampan bernama Liu Ta-lung.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Seorang peneliti muda berubah menjadi Inframan bertangan petir demi melawan Ibu Putri Naga yang bangun dari hibernasi untuk menaklukkan bumi bersama dengan pasukan monster mutannya.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: Idola tahun '70-an, Hsing Hui dan Yon Fan, membintangi film horor yang bercerita tentang pengusaha muda yang menikahi wanita muda nan cantik tanpa menyadari jika sang gadis dirasuki oleh iblis.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: David Chiang berperan sebagai Pangeran ke-13, seorang petarung muda yang perkasa. Status istimewa yang ia miliki menimbulkan kecemburuan dan perseteruan keluarga yang mengerikan.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: Seorang penulis yang putus asa menjalin persahabatan yang tidak terduga dengan seorang remaja dari Long Island.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Seluruh sekolah disandera saat kompetisi pidato bahasa Inggris berlangsung. Ip Man pun memutuskan untuk bangkit dan menghadapi krisis, serta menemukan bahwa dalangnya adalah sang guru dan teman masa kecilnya.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Berlatar tiga tahun setelah Dragon Inn, pemilik penginapan Jade telah menghilang dan sebuah penginapan baru telah bangkit dari reruntuhan - penginapan yang dikelola oleh para perampok yang menyamar sebagai warga negara yang taat hukum, yang berharap untuk menggali kota hilang yang legendaris yang terkubur di gurun.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta Tao dan para pendamping rohnya harus berpisah setelah ia memutuskan untuk membantu seorang pemburu vampir, yang ingin mengalahkan seorang penyihir jahat dan para pengikutnya.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Monyet Batu, memberikan harapan kepada seorang gadis kecil nan putus asa. Namun, Monyet Batu dikalahkan dalam pertempuran melawan Dewa Perang bermata tiga, yang membuatnya kehilangan kekuatan dan jatuh ke dunia fana.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: Raja Naga dikunci dalam segel oleh Tuan Naga selama 500 tahun, dan putri sang Raja harus kembali ke masa lalu guna membunuh Tuan Naga saat mengetahui bahwa keduanya adalah teman dekat di masa lalu.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: Shaolin (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Seorang playboy kaya tewas akibat diledakkan oleh seorang gangster ketika ia menggoda istri gangster tersebut. Melalui serangkaian kejadian, profesornya membuatkan tubuh sintetis yang memungkinkannya untuk berubah menjadi apa pun yang diinginkannya.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: Saat belajar di Jepang, Chen Zhen menemukan beberapa pelajar asal Tiongkok menghilang dan tanpa sengaja mengungkap sejumlah konspirasi kelompok Naga Hitam.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Di Cina tahun 1920-an, seorang bandit tiba di kota provinsi terpencil dengan menyamar sebagai wali kota baru, di mana ia berhadapan dengan bangsawan lokal yang kejam.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Seorang fotografer terjerat oleh sesosok 'wanita berbaju merah' hingga menyebabkan kerabatnya tewas satu per satu. Ia pun bersumpah untuk mencari tahu kebenarannya saat gadis yang ia sukai juga tewas secara misterius.

programme.desc: Northern Borders' mengisahkan tentang Austen Kittredge yang berusia sepuluh tahun, yang dikirim oleh ayahnya untuk tinggal di pertanian kakek-neneknya di Vermont. Ceritanya berlatar tahun 1956, dan Austen merasakan pertanian itu sebagai tempat yang penuh dengan orang-orang eksentrik, terutama kakek-neneknya yang keras kepala, yang pernikahan mereka yang penuh masalah dikenal sebagai Perang Empat Puluh Tahun. Awalnya merasa terjebak di rumah tangga yang retak ini, Austen muda berencana untuk segera pergi, tetapi akhirnya terdampar tanpa pilihan selain beradaptasi dan bertahan. Sebuah kisah pendewasaan yang lucu dan terkadang mengejutkan, 'Northern Borders' membangkitkan nuansa liar Vermont, keindahannya yang luar biasa, masa lalu yang kelam, dan aura pesona.

Ketika batas antara realitas dan dunia pikiran semakin kabur, Mason harus menghadapi konspirasi, ancaman, dan pertanyaan mendalam mengenai kesadaran, kebebasan, serta dampak dari sebuah inovasi yang melampaui batas kemampuan manusia. programme.desc: Meral (8) baru saja pindah ke sebuah kota baru. Di rumah, ia berteman dengan seekor tikus kecil yang tinggal di kamar barunya, yang ia beri nama Peepeep. Ketika seekor burung hantu menangkap tikus kecil tersebut, Meral menyalahkan teman-teman barunya. Baru setelah mereka bersama-sama pergi ke alam liar untuk mencari muntahan burung hantu yang berisi tulang-belulang Peepeep, Meral akhirnya memahami arti sebenarnya dari persahabatan. programme.title: Anak Magang Bikin Sayang

Salah satu petinju terhebat sepanjang masa akan tampil hanya satu tahun setelah menjalani debut profesionalnya, saat "Pretty Boy" dengan rekor 10-0, Floyd Mayweather - jauh sebelum ia menjadi "Money" - akan menghadapi ujian berat melawan Felipe Garcia dari Meksiko. Mayweather telah menunjukkan bakat yang akan membuatnya menjadi superstar dunia, dengan kecepatan kilat, pertahanan yang luar biasa, dan kekuatan yang mengejutkan untuk pria seukurannya. Saksikan Floyd Mayweather yang masih berusia 20 tahun dalam episode Greatest Classics, di FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: The Curse Of Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Seorang pria mewarisi rumah leluhurnya dan sebuah kutukan kuno yang berasal dari Perang Salib.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: Angkatan Laut Jerman dan kapal-kapal U-Boat yang tersisa bergabung untuk satu misi terakhir guna menyerang Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: American Muscle
programme.desc: Setelah menjalani masa tahanan selama 10 tahun, seorang mantan narapidana memiliki waktu 24 jam untuk membalas dendam pada orang-orang yang memasukkannya ke dalam penjara.

programme.title: Unnatural
programme.desc: Perubahan iklim dunia membuat sebuah perusahaan melakukan rekayasa genetik pada sekelompok beruang kutub Alaska yang ternyata memberi dampak nan mengerikan dan mematikan.

programme.title: Havenhurst
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda nan bermasalah tinggal di sebuah apartemen tua tempat ia harus menghadapi sesosok iblis yang mengerikan.

programme.title: Murder Syndicate
programme.desc: Ketika matriark dari sebuah keluarga pembunuh bayaran jatuh sakit, ketiga anaknya dan pacarnya yang lebih muda saling berebut untuk mengambil alih kerajaan bisnisnya.

programme.title: Exists
programme.desc: Sekelompok teman menjalajahi kawasan hutan terpencil di Texas untuk bersenang-senang di akhir pekan, namun mereka dibuntuti oleh Bigfoot.

programme.title: The Ballad Of Davy Crockett
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1815, seorang Legenda Amerika, yang istrinya jatuh sakit parah, meninggalkan anak-anaknya yang masih kecil untuk bertahan hidup sendirian, harus berjuang untuk kembali menemui mereka melewati banyak bahaya yang ditemukan di Savage Lands di daerah perbatasan yang liar.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: Seorang kurir khusus ditugaskan untuk mengirim sebuah kotak misterius ke dunia pembunuh bayaran nan berbahaya.

programme.title: Death On The Border
programme.desc: Dua wanita yang gigih berupaya melepaskan diri dari hubungan penuh kekerasan dengan seorang detektif bejat yang berada di titik terendah, bertekad untuk memindahkan gadis-gadis korban perdagangan seks melintasi perbatasan Meksiko.

programme.title: No Visitors
programme.desc: Lewis Cutterman, dokter bedah terhormat, menyimpan rahasia kelam. Keluarganya membius tamu lalu memakan tubuhnya sedikit demi sedikit untuk memperdagangkan organ demi pasien kaya.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1876, seorang pemburu bayaran melacak saudaranya sendiri di seluruh Montana dengan bantuan seorang pemburu hewan ilegal.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tersiksa oleh masa lalunya, seorang petugas kebersihan bernama Clean mencoba menjalani kehidupan yang tenang. Tak lama kemudian, ia dipaksa untuk berdamai dengan kekerasan masa lalunya.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Berlatar saat Perang Dunia II, sekelompok tentara Angkatan Darat Amerika dikirim dalam misi rahasia untuk menemukan komandan mereka yang hilang.

programme.title: S.W.A.T. (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang gembong narkoba yang dipenjara menawarkan hadiah uang tunai besar kepada siapa pun yang dapat membebaskannya dari tahanan polisi, dan hanya tim Senjata dan Taktik Khusus LAPD yang dapat mencegahnya.

programme.title: Here Comes The Boom
programme.desc: Seorang guru biologi ikut bertarung dalam pertandingan seni bela diri campuran untuk mengumpulkan dana demi menyelamatkan program musik di sekolah tempatnya mengajar.

programme.title: Slender Man
programme.desc: Empat siswi SMA menggelar sebuah upacara untuk memanggil hantu internet yang bernama Slenderman. Namun, si hantu tak dapat disingkirkan dan satu per satu dari mereka menjadi gila, mati, dan menghilang.

programme.title: The 5th Wave
programme.desc: Serangan alien mematikan yang terjadi dalam empat gelombang telah membuat Bumi hancur. Kini, Cassie harus bersiap untuk menghadapi gelombang ke-lima sembari berusaha menyelamatkan saudaranya.

programme.title: Holmes And Watson
programme.desc: Detektif terhebat di dunia dan rekannya bekerja sama untuk memecahkan kasus pembunuhan di Istana Buckingham sebelum sang Ratu menjadi korban berikutnya.

programme.title: Holmes And Watson
programme.desc: Detektif terhebat di dunia dan rekannya bekerja sama untuk memecahkan kasus pembunuhan di Istana Buckingham sebelum sang Ratu menjadi korban berikutnya.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Seorang bocah yang dihantui oleh bayangan menara kegelapan dari dunia paralel bekerja sama dengan penjaga menara untuk mencegah sesosok mahluk jahat yang ingin menghancurkan menara tersebut dan membuka gerbang neraka.

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri terbangun dan mendapati rekaman seks yang mereka buat malam sebelumnya telah hilang, yang mengakibatkan mereka panik dan mencari keberadaan rekaman tersebut.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Saat remaja, Donny menjadi ayah seorang putra, Todd, dan membesarkannya sebagai orang tua tunggal hingga Todd berusia 18 tahun.

programme.title: Zoom
programme.desc: Mantan superhero Jack dipanggil kembali untuk bekerja mengubah sekelompok anak-anak yang tidak terduga menjadi superhero di sebuah akademi swasta.

programme.title: Men In Black: International
programme.desc: Men In Black selalu melindungi Bumi dari penjahat alam semesta. Di petualangan baru ini, mereka mengatasi ancaman terbesar dan paling global hingga kini, yakni seorang pengkhianat di organisasi.

programme.title: The Possession Of Hannah Grace (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Ketika seorang polisi wanita yang baru saja keluar dari rehabilitasi mengambil giliran kerja malam di kamar mayat rumah sakit kota, dia menghadapi serangkaian peristiwa aneh dan penuh kekerasan yang disebabkan oleh entitas jahat di salah satu mayat.

programme.title: The Bronze (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang mantan peraih medali perunggu senam yang bermulut kotor dan memiliki status selebriti lokal dengan enggan melatih seorang calon atlet Olimpiade yang sedang naik daun.

programme.title: Salt (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Kehidupan agen CIA, Evelyn Salt, berubah drastis ketika ia dituduh merencanakan pembunuhan Presiden Rusia. Demi membuktikan bahwa dirinya tidak bersalah, Salt melarikan diri dan memulai perjalanan berbahaya untuk mengungkap kebenaran.

programme.title: Venom (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Seorang reporter yang gagal menjalin ikatan dengan sesosok alien, salah satu parasit yang menginvasi Bumi. Namun, makhluk tersebut menyukai Bumi dan memutuskan untuk melindunginya.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: David Lord terpaksa masuk ke dunia brutal arena gladiator modern, tempat para pria bertarung hingga mati demi menghibur jutaan penonton di dunia maya.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Empat minggu setelah virus misterius yang tidak dapat disembuhkan menyebar ke seluruh Inggris, segelintir orang yang selamat mencoba mencari tempat perlindungan.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: Mary adalah seorang pembunuh bayaran yang bekerja untuk sebuah keluarga kejahatan terorganisir di Boston, yang hidupnya berubah total ketika dia bertemu dengan seorang anak laki-laki yang secara tak sengaja berpapasan dengannya saat sebuah misi pembunuhan profesional gagal.

programme.title: The Emoji Movie
programme.desc: Gene, emoji multiekspresi, memulai perjalanan untuk menjadi emoji normal.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: Saat sebuah ancaman nan membahayakan muncul, Red, Chuck, Bomb, dan Mighty Eagle merekrut saudara Chuck dan bekerja sama dengan para babi untuk melakukan gencatan senjata demi menyelamatkan rumah mereka.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: Gembong narkoba yang dipenjara menawarkan hadiah uang tunai dalam jumlah besar bagi siapa saja yang dapat membebaskannya dari tahanan polisi, dan hanya tim Senjata dan Taktik Khusus L.A.P.D. yang dapat mencegahnya.

programme.desc: Dalam serangkaian duel fashion satu lawan satu, para desainer menciptakan busana berani yang terinspirasi dari hewan liar. Model tamu spesial dari jajaran program Get Real di Hulu akan memperagakan karya mereka di atas runway.

programme.title: Matlock S2: Harm Reduction
programme.desc: Matty dan Olympia terus menguji batas persahabatan mereka sambil membantu sekelompok biarawati; Olympia dan Sarah terseret ke dalam aktivitas rahasia di dalam perusahaan tersebut.

programme.title: Sheriff Country S2: Maria
programme.desc: Saat perburuan berbahaya semakin intensif di Deadwater, Mickey berpacu melawan waktu untuk melindungi nyawa yang rentan, sementara luka keluarga yang telah lama terkubur memaksanya untuk menghadapi masa lalu.

programme.title: Fire Country S5: Winners And...
programme.desc: Saat kontroversi yang semakin membesar membuat Stasiun 42 berada di bawah pengawasan ketat, Bode dan para petugas pemadam kebakaran sukarelawan menghadapi ujian berat yang membawa mereka pada penyelamatan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Family Feud, Ep 15
programme.desc: Steve Harvey memandu dua keluarga yang saling menebak jawaban survei. Mereka berebut peluang pass atau play, dan keluarga pemenang maju ke babak bonus untuk meraih hadiah uang tunai.

programme.title: Ghosts S5: The Investor
programme.desc: Ketika kesempatan menjanjikan untuk menyelamatkan Woodstone terancam oleh konflik pribadi, Sam dan Jay terpaksa membuat pilihan sulit. Sementara itu, hari pemilihan tiba dan Flower serta Isaac bersaing ketat untuk menjadi Perwakilan Hantu.

programme.title: FBI S9: Ultimatum
programme.desc: Bahan yang sangat radioaktif dicuri dari fasilitas pembuangan limbah medis, sehingga tim harus melacak pencurinya. Eva mendapati dirinya berada di tengah situasi yang genting.

programme.title: Titipo Titipo 2

Sekarang dia ada di halaman belakang rumah Liz, memintanya untuk menyembunyikannya setelah melarikan diri dari penjara. Liz setuju untuk membantu setelah suaminya keluar dari rumah.

programme.title: Wild Side Of The Moon S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Film Wild Side of the Moon, yang dinarasikan oleh Tilda Swinton, mengungkap bagaimana kekuatan bulan memengaruhi makhluk hidup di seluruh penjuru dunia. Mulai dari seekor bayi gajah yang menghadapi ancaman predator di bawah cahaya bulan yang terus berubah, rubah Arktik yang membesarkan anak-anaknya di tengah siklus musim yang ekstrem, hingga paus bungkuk yang melintasi lautan luas dengan dipandu oleh sinyal-sinyal bulan, kisah setiap hewan tersebut tergambarkan dengan sangat hidup.

programme.title: Zak Storm

Zack dijadikan kapten kapal Chaos, sehingga mengharuskannya untuk bekerja sama dengan pedang ajaib yang bisa berbicara bernama Calabrass guna menghadapi berbagai bahaya di negeri tersebut.

programme.title: Rumahnya Anak : Kiko
programme.desc: Program animasi tentang Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki. Cerita bermula saat danau tempat tinggal Kiko tercemar limbah beracun akibat ulah sembrono manusia. Hal ini membuat Kiko dan kawan-kawannya berubah menjadi mutan. Mereka pun tumbuh menjadi makhluk air yang bisa bicara, layaknya manusia. Dan, petualangan pun dimulai.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. programme.title: HUNTER X HUNTER
programme.desc: Kisah Hunter × Hunter berfokus pada seorang anak laki-laki bernama Gon Freecss, yang suatu hari menemukan bahwa ayahnya yang selama ini diberitahu telah meninggal, masih hidup dan sehat. programme.title: Ultraman Teo

Saat Monster Yang Sama Menyerang Bumi, Tekadnya Melindungi Makhluk Hidup Mengubahnya Menjadi Ultraman.

programme.title: Ultraman Teo

Ketika krisis yang menghancurkan planet asalnya terjadi di Bumi, dia berdiri dengan keinginan kuat untuk bertarung dan berubah menjadi raksasa cahaya biru.

programme.title: Yaiba Samurai Legend

Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Best Friend (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang pemimpin partai oposisi di Korea Selatan pada era 1980-an berjuang untuk mengungguli pemerintah, tanpa menyadari bahwa sebuah tim pengintai telah ditempatkan di rumah sebelah untuk mengawasi gerak-geriknya. Kisah ini diangkat dari kehidupan Kim Dae-jung, Presiden Korea Selatan ke-8.

programme.title: Ditto
programme.desc: Ditto mengisahkan seorang mahasiswa teknik di sebuah universitas bernama Kim Yong. Dia mulai masuk kuliah tahun 1995, namun harus cuti hingga tahun 1999 karena menjalani wajib militer. Suatu hari, Yong menemukan sebuah radio antik yang bisa terhubung dengan masa depan. Yong berkomunikasi dengan Kim Mu-Nee, seorang mahasiswi yang hidup dimasa sekarang, berkuliah di jurusan sosiologi. Komunikasi dari dua periode berbeda ini membuat kisah hidup mereka terungkap satu sama lain.

programme.title: The Childe

Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: All About Christmas Eve
programme.desc: A meticulous Christmas expert and bestselling author, Adeline Wilson, clashes with a laid-back bookstore owner, Garth Bowman, during her final stop on a lackluster holiday book tour. When a playful bet pits her structured holiday traditions against his spontaneous festive spirit, Adie decides to stay in town to prove her methods. As their rivalry unfolds, unexpected sparks fly, transforming their competition into a heartwarming journey of love, self-discovery, and the true magic of Christmas.

programme.title: Lightning Jack
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.

programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.desc: An actor (Morgan Freeman) who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet (Paz Vega), a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Vamps

programme.title: BloodRayne

When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

When the unbalanced Corky fears he won't pass the required mental exam, he runs away with Fats to his hometown, where he meets an old love from high school, Peggy (Ann-Margret). Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.

programme.title: 99 Homes

Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow

He becomes the brightest star of neo-Expressionist painting and one of the most successful painters of his time, and even develops a friendship with Andy Warhol (David Bowie). But Basquiat's tumultuous life, specifically his addiction to heroin, overshadows his rise to fame, threatening all.

Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

As they renovate the house, they look for a tenant for the first floor of their house. Carter Hayes (Michael Keaton) seems like a great fit at first, but it transpires that he is a con artist who plans to swindle them out of their real estate. programme.title: Eat My Dust!
programme.desc: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

Temple's advantage is that as a chronicler of punk from its earliest days, he could call on his own archive footage as well as that shot by others over the years.

After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

But, when they get involved with some very dangerous characters in the drug industry, the men start to question the wisdom of their scheme.

programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.desc: Three years after a fateful trip to the French Riviera, Jen (Katherine Heigl) enjoys the good life in suburbia with her handsome husband, Spencer (Ashton Kutcher). That comes crashing down, however, when gunfire rings out the morning after his 30th birthday. It turns out that Spencer has not been honest with Jen about his job; he's a deadly spy. Now she must learn to dodge bullets while keeping up an appearance of normalcy.

programme.desc: Best friends Audrey and Morgan are going about their humdrum lives in Los Angeles -- until Audrey's ex-boyfriend suddenly shows up with a team of deadly assassins on his trail. Unexpectedly thrust into an international conspiracy, the gals soon find themselves dodging killers and a suspicious British agent while hatching a plan to save the world.

programme.title: Miller's Girl

However, Simon's vengeance is as inevitable as it is shattering, and once unleashed, it tests her strength, her courage, and the bonds of deep-rooted friendships.

programme.desc: Alone and trapped in a locked-down hospital isolation ward overnight, an injured young woman must escape a pair of vicious killers who are after the only piece of evidence that can implicate them in a grisly murder: the bullet in her leg.

programme.desc: Two FBI agents cross paths with Crawford, a Florida cop who's investigating a string of murders that appear to be related. When an undercover sting goes horribly wrong, Crawford soon finds himself in a twisted game of cat and mouse with the killer.

programme.desc: Luke Wright is a two-bit cage fighter, until the day he throws a fixed match. In retaliation, the Russian mob murders his family and destroys his life. The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

programme.desc: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When a comedy of errors causes Orange, Plum and Cherry to arrive late to their campout, they start off their annual tradition of telling tall-tales around the campfire.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling "Tall Tales." So Apple tells her thrilling adventure of a wild road rally she entered, only to surprise the girls by proving the story is actually true.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City.
